content.value: Suppose A is transmitting a packet to B. They are directly connected through a physical link. (12) The length of the link is 1 km, the length of the packet is L bits and the transmission rate is 1 Mbps. (i) Now calculate how many bits will be arrived at B in 50 μsec? (ii) If the packet length is 100 bytes then at what transmission rate R, the propagation delay would be equal to the transmisşion delay of packet?
